messages:
anita: Quick pulse on ElmCorp — onboarding looks green on seat training but renewal NPS dipped to 6 in last survey. Thinking we should run a prefill + lightweight warm pool for their high-traffic flows this week.

raj: saw the NPS, thanks. which flows are high-traffic?

anita: mostly support chat and content-generation batch jobs at 10am PST. spikes cause 400ms->1.4s tail latency occasionally.

sara: for those, caching prefix tokens and enabling short TTL KV cache helped another customer. also suggest streaming fallback for interactive chat to mask retries. :white_check_mark:

tomo: agree. propose: 1) scheduled prefill at 9:45am 2) set batch window 50ms for batch endpoints 3) enable streaming with chunked response for chat endpoints.

raj: who will own the prefill run? I can schedule a warmup job but need the exact curl to prime the tenant.

anita: @raj i'll DM the dataset list. quick helper command (paste into ops box):
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/warmup
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $RID"
  -d '{"tenant":"elmcorp","routes":["/chat","/batch/generate"],"prefill_size":200}'
```

cs-ops-bot: Scheduled warmup job created: job_id=wm-2024-09-12-elm-01, run_at=1724686350

sara: for batching: recommend 50ms max window and max_batch_tokens=1024 to keep latency SLOs. add jitter to avoid thundering herd.

tomo: fallback plan: if 5xx or queue depth > 80% route to smaller quantized model variant and stream partial output. update routing policy in console under 'rollouts' -> elmcorp-canary.

raj: logging checklist? want to capture prefill success, cache-hit ratio, and renewal NPS tag.

anita: yep: add these traces/events: prefill.started, prefill.completed, cache.hit_ratio, batch.avg_latency_50p/95p/99p, routing.fallback_trigger. also tag tenant:renewal_risk=medium.

sara: capture user feedback hook post-onboard: quick 3-question pulse after 48h. tie responses into ticket if NPS <7.

tomo: I'll update the runbook snippet in Confluence and push the config. assigning tasks: @raj schedule warmup + monitor, @sara implement feedback hook, @anita own renewal outreach if metrics stay low. :rocket:

anita: thanks all — pls drop any gotchas here. if prefill fails, fallback is to increase batch window to 100ms temporarily and throttle clients.

raj: noted, scheduling now. will report back after run.

cs-ops-bot: Warmup job completed: job_id=wm-2024-09-12-elm-01 status=success duration=18s prefilled=198 routes=2

anita: awesome, monitoring dashboard set. see you on the 11am sync if anything spikes. :eyes:
